function: Attention-based PPO agent at the BS decides model split point, server computing-frequency shares and uplink bandwidth shares of UAV clients each training round (p. 11, Algorithm 3).
system: One BS at [0,0,30] m and K=9 to 45 UAV clients, FDD, 2 GHz, 20 MHz per link, scalar gain; antennas not stated; no RIS (pp. 4, 12, 17).
method: PPO actor-critic reinforcement learning with attention encoder of UAV trajectories and MLPs with three hidden layers; trained online across SFL rounds within each scenario (pp. 10-13).
data_channel: Simulated: 3GPP TR 36.777 RMa-AV LOS path loss only, distance-based gain; UAV tracks from Gauss-Markov and predefined-direction mobility; Swin-L LoRA on CIFAR-100 (p. 12).
test_conditions: Policy trained and scored online within each scenario: Gauss-Markov with 9 UAVs (Fig. 12), predefined direction with 10 UAVs (Fig. 13); last 1000 rounds scored; no unseen condition (p. 16).
baselines: Non-learned CCRA: equal shares, equal-rate bandwidth heuristic; fixed split points. Own DRL without attention; DRL with PipeSFL. No earlier learned SPS/CCRA method (pp. 15-16).
metrics: Average per-round latency, maximum UAV energy per round, their weighted objective (14a), and policy inference latency in ms (pp. 13, 15-17).
complexity: Policy-network inference latency 24.72 ms for K=9 to 59.93 ms for K=45 on an NVIDIA T400 GPU, Table VII (p. 17).
openness: none; only IEEE supplementary material (appendix proofs), no code or data link (pp. 1, 7).
q1_support: p. 12: "follows the RMa-AV LOS model in 3GPP TR 36.777". Only the path loss formula comes from 3GPP and the gain is h = 10^(-L/10) with no fading, a custom simulator, so not met.
q2_support: p. 16: "Then, we conduct simulations in the scenario illustrated". The DRL is trained and scored inside each of two mobility scenarios (Figs. 12, 13); no trained policy is tested on another mobility model, K or channel, so not met.
q3_support: p. 15: "Thus, the attention mechanism is not involved." DRL(-) is an ablation, and equal RA and heuristic RA are non-learned CCRA baselines. No earlier learned SPS/CCRA method or other DRL algorithm is run, so not met.
q4_support: p. 17: "the policy inference latencies remain below 0.1 s". Table VII reports the measured inference latency of the policy network on an NVIDIA T400 GPU for K=9 to 45.
q5_support: p. 12: "CIFAR-100 dataset, where the input size is 3*224*224". A public dataset of the learning task alone does not count, the channel is simulated, and p. 1 mentions only supplementary material (appendix proofs, p. 7), no code link.
notes: Eligibility is borderline. The learned PHY-side decision is only the uplink bandwidth split among UAVs (Algorithm 3, p. 11); split point and server computing frequency are edge-computing decisions above the physical layer. Kept under the aerial-link rule (learned resource allocation, jointly with decisions above) and area 6; aggregation is digital over rate-limited links (pp. 4-5), so not area 7. If the reviewer reads it as FL and edge-computing management, the code would be above_phy. The CPSFL priority scheduling is not learned (pp. 6-7). q1 uses only the TR 36.777 path loss formula, which does not count.
